text: もうすこしで　つかまえられたのに！

structure.en: I could have caught it, and yet!

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end means 'even though', with regret that it did not work out. つかまえられたのに = 'and I could have caught it!'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: This ending adds 'can' to a verb; here it is in the past. つかまえられた = 'could catch'.
